children.name: Gateway as single LangGraph runtime + IM channels
Version lockstep: pyproject + package.json + helm chart
Full monorepo not runnable in this sandbox without Docker + API keys
gog CLI not installed; Drive via connected tools only
Catalog has 4344 skills — need selective install, not bulk
Vercel deploy needs project binding and secrets
SuperAgent harness = lead agent + skills + subagents + sandbox + memory
Ontology: Skills ⊂ Capabilities, Tools ⊂ Actions, Plugins ⊂ Extensions
Knowledge graph: Skill --uses--> Tool --served_by--> Service --exposes--> API

insights.text: DeerFlow 2.x is a SuperAgent harness (LangGraph + Next.js), not just a research pipeline.
Public skills cover research, media generation, skill meta-tools, and deploy — a full creator loop.
skill-creator is the primary meta-skill; skill-reviewer + contracts enforce quality gates.
Catalog.json indexes 4344 external skills across 30+ categories — integration layer needed.
Extension-first design: prefer packages under plugins/ over core modifications.
Connected stack for this workspace: Drive (ingest/backup), GitHub (repo), Vercel (frontend deploy).

critic.text: Eval fixture skills excluded from production master tree.
Bootstrap skill description frontmatter incomplete (>- only).
Large binary assets and node_modules intentionally not mirrored.
